# Persistent AI Studio

> Open-source Agent Skill for persistent, human-led, governed multi-agent product work.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/fanfanfanfanfan626/orchestrate-agent-organization
Skill ID: orchestrate-agent-organization
Current release: 1.0.2
License: MIT
Languages: English, Simplified Chinese

## Use it when

- Product or material feature work must persist across tasks.
- A portfolio choice, finite investment horizon, or operate/pause/retire decision is needed.
- A complex authorized project needs an automatically sized, governed multi-agent organization.
- Product ownership, reality evidence, maintenance, or retirement must remain durable.

## Do not use it for

- Small, tightly sequential tasks one agent can finish efficiently.
- Organizational theater or simulated departments.
- Replacing human authorization, external evidence, security review, or professional judgment.
